newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO Pac to spend US$300mln on containers.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pac to spend US$300mln on containers.

text.p: China-backed COSCO Pacific Ltd will spend a total US$300 million to purchase new containers in 1997, deputy general manager Kelvin Wong said on Tuesday.
Half of the HK$1.55 billion recently raised from its 250 million share placement would be used to buy containers with the remainder going to working capital, Wong told a news conference.
"We plan to buy 80,000 to 100,000 TEU (20-foot equivalent units) dry containers and 10,000 refrigerated containers next year," said director Luk Chi Wing.
He said the expansion in container leasing sector would be relatively fast next year and required the additional funds.
COSCO Pacific bought a total of 40,000 TEUs in 1995, lifting total containers it owned to 300,000 TEUs by the end of 1995.
The number rose further to 310,000 TEUs as of June 30.

About 50,000 TEUs of the dry containers and most of the 10,000 refrigerated containers to be purchased next year would be used to satisfy additional demand from parent China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO), Luk said.
COSCO, which has 56.6 percent interest in COSCO Pacific, is the largest single customer of the container leasing and terminal operation company.
